name: L&I Contractor License Data - Insurance
description: State of Washington, Labor & Industries contractor license and insurance data

columns.name: BusinessName
columns.description: The registered name in which the contractor is doing business as.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseNumber
columns.description: The Contractor License Number is the unique combination of letters, numbers and symbols that are specific and unique to a contractor. This license number is generated by L&I.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseTypeCode
columns.description: An abbreviation which identifies the Contractor License Type.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseTypeCodeDesc
columns.description: Identification of the type of contractor license.

columns.name: LicenseStatus
columns.description: Abbreviation of the contractor license status.

columns.name: UBI
columns.description: Unified Business Identifier (UBI) is a nine digit number that registers you with several state agencies and allows you to do business in Washington State.

columns.name: InsuranceCompany
columns.description: The insurance agency where the contractor obtained their insurance from.

columns.name: InsurancePolicyNo
columns.description: The policy number reported on the contractor's insurance policy.

columns.name: InsuranceAmt
columns.description: The general liability insurance amount per occurrence.

columns.name: EffectiveDate
columns.description: The date the insurance policy became effective.

columns.name: ExpirationDate
columns.description: The date the insurance policy expired.

columns.name: CancelDate
columns.description: The date the insurance policy was cancelled.

columns.name: CreateDate
columns.description: The date the insurance policy was created.

columns.name: CreatedBy_WAOIC_ID
columns.description: ID of the individual who input the insurance policy into L&I's licensing database.

columns.name: LastUpdateDate
columns.description: Date that the insurance was last updated on.

columns.name: UpdatedBy_WAOIC_ID
columns.description: ID of the individual who last updated the insurance policy.

columns.name: InsuranceAgencyName
columns.description: Name of insurance agency that updated the insurance policy.

L&I Contractor Insurance Data is updated thee times per day: 8:00 a.m., 12:15 p.m., 5:15 p.m.
